persistedQueryReceipts.scope: Only public ADS bibliographic metadata is retained. CTAS does not download, mirror, or assert reuse rights for article full text; publisher and repository links retain their own access and reuse terms. Event association requires an exact retained transient name.

Rubin alert packets are world-public with no proprietary period, and Fink documents its LSST Science Portal and REST API as real-time, public services requiring no login. Coordinate and first-detection proximity are not proof of source identity.

ZTF alert difference-image PSF photometry; non-detections are retained as upper limits, not forced photometry. Coordinate association does not assert identity. Public ZTF alert photometry served by the ALeRCE broker. Cite Förster et al. (2021), AJ 161, 242, and acknowledge ALeRCE and the Zwicky Transient Facility according to current provider guidance.

evidence_timeline.summary: Here we report the ATLAS discovery of the transient ATLAS25fwv (AT2025mvn) in galaxy NGC 5033 at magnitude m_o = 18.22 +/- 0.14. At a distance of 18 Mpc, the transient was discovered on MJD = 60829.32 (2025-06-03.32) with an absolute magnitude of M = -13.0 +/- 0.2. The last non-detection through forced photometry was on MJD = 60827.32. This is potentially a very young supernova, and rapid followup observations are encouraged.

publications.abstract: We observed SN 2025mvn (ATLAS25fwv) using the 1-meter telescopes in Altay, Xinjiang. Our observations confirm a rapid rise of 0.7 magnitudes in the r-band within 9 hours following the discovery, consistent with characteristics of a young Type II SN.

publications.abstract: Here we report the ATLAS discovery of the transient ATLAS25fwv (AT2025mvn) in galaxy NGC 5033 at magnitude m_o = 18.22 +/- 0.14. At a distance of 18 Mpc, the transient was discovered on MJD = 60829.32 (2025-06-03.32) with an absolute magnitude of M = -13.0 +/- 0.2. The last non-detection through forced photometry was on MJD = 60827.32. This is potentially a very young supernova, and rapid followup observations are encouraged.

persistedQueryReceipts.scope: Only public ADS bibliographic metadata is retained. CTAS does not download, mirror, or assert reuse rights for article full text; publisher and repository links retain their own access and reuse terms. Event association requires an exact retained transient name.

Rubin alert packets are world-public with no proprietary period, and Fink documents its LSST Science Portal and REST API as real-time, public services requiring no login. Coordinate and first-detection proximity are not proof of source identity.

WISeREP's official help states that private data require a personal API key for scripted access. CTAS sends no credentials, requests public=yes explicitly, and accepts only rows independently marked public=1 from the anonymous public export.

A zero result means ALeRCE holds no public ZTF alert object at this position in the window; it is not a forced-photometry nondetection. Public ZTF alert photometry served by the ALeRCE broker. Cite Förster et al. (2021), AJ 161, 242, and acknowledge ALeRCE and the Zwicky Transient Facility according to current provider guidance.
